title: omx-contract vocabulary
description: GENERATED by `omx-contract render --target json` from data/: one enum per codes and words item of the vocabulary (docs/data-layout.md), for a schema that references the words instead of repeating them. GPL-3.0-or-later.

RESOURCE_KINDS.description: Every resource a host plans a plugin for (FreeMixer/plugin-qualify#116): each measured per machine class, judged per host profile, and unknown, never a pass, when it has no figure.

text.en: The cost per sample at a rate and quantum, its percentile and its tail.
The footprint per instance and its growth over a soak.
The memory a plugin asks of its host for its process call.
The frames a plugin delays its output by, per rate and quantum.
How long a plugin keeps sounding once its input goes silent.
The notes an instrument plays at once.
The wall time of instantiate, activate and the first block.
The threads a plugin starts and their scheduling class, or the host thread pool it asks for.
The work a plugin hands to a non-real-time thread of the host.
The block lengths a plugin accepts.
The file descriptors a plugin holds after activate, and their growth.
The bytes a plugin reads at load and while it processes.
Any socket a plugin opens.
The size of a plugin's saved state, its save and restore time, and its round trip.

RESOURCE_HINTS.description: What a plugin declares about its own footprint, in openmixer's own hints (FreeMixer/plugin-qualify#116): each a claim plugin-qualify measures and checks, carried by the extension below, as the CLAP draft and as LV2 properties. A hint a plugin does not state is unknown, never zero.

The wall time of activate and the first block the plugin expects.

PARAM_UNITS.description: The one list of standard units (the owner's ruling of 2026-11-20, standard vocabulary in one place; docs/units.md): each word's `x-symbol` is its symbol as written (`%`, `""`, `dB/oct`), the word a name the wire can carry, its `x-dimension` what it measures (a word of PARAM_UNIT_DIMENSIONS) and its group its scope (a word of PARAM_UNIT_SCOPES). The schema's $defs.unit enum is the ids (consts) of the `param` units and $defs.descriptorUnit those of the `descriptor` units and `unknown`, in this order (tools/unit-enum.mjs): the id is the wire word, the `x-symbol` its display rendering only (C2, plugin-hostd#215 D1/D2). A word's code is its position in the list, not a wire number (the wire codes are omx-clap's, the unit codes of org.openmixer.param-contract/1): a reader takes the words, so a unit removed shifts the codes after it (omx-contract#167: `x` went, `coef` is the plain multiplier). A level's own spellings (an LV2 unit, a CLAP unit code) map onto these ids at that level.

PARAM_UNIT_DIMENSIONS.description: What a unit of PARAM_UNITS measures (docs/units.md, The dimensions): two units of one dimension measure the same kind of quantity (ms and s, Hz and kHz), so a reader can tell which units a value may be shown in. The word `count` has the key `counted`: OMX_PARAM_UNIT_DIMENSIONS_COUNT is the number of words.

PARAM_UNIT_SCOPES.description: Where a unit of PARAM_UNITS may be stated (docs/units.md, Q16 ruled: the split is kept): `param`, a unit of the items, the schema's $defs.unit; `descriptor`, a unit only a descriptor's control states, the schema's $defs.descriptorUnit.

text.en: A unit of the items, which a descriptor states too.
A unit only a descriptor's control states.

PARAM_UNITS_CLAP_ENCODED.description: The standard units the CLAP extension org.openmixer.param-contract/1 encodes (docs/units.md, V23d B2): the ids that have a unit code at the CLAP level, each a word of PARAM_UNITS taken from it, in its order. omx-panel reads it to know whether a unit can be served; omx-clap's map check holds its code-to-id mapping onto it. The codes are omx-clap's; this item names none.
